name: 98056 · Renton, WA
findings: ZIP 98056 (Renton) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98056 (Renton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98056 (Renton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
